# Sutori

> > Sutori is an educational presentation and storytelling platform that integrates with Google Classroom, Microsoft Office 365, and Clever for collaborative learning.

Sutori provides tools for teachers and students to create interactive timelines, presentations, and collaborative projects. The platform supports multiple authentication methods including Google, Microsoft, Clever, and Facebook to streamline classroom integration.

## Key Topics

- Sutori platform
- Google Classroom integration
- Microsoft Office 365 integration
- Clever authentication
- Student onboarding
- Teacher-student connection
- Account registration
- User authentication methods
- Getting started guides
- Educational collaboration
- Interactive presentations
- Timeline creation

## Getting Started

- [How do I sign up?](https://help.sutori.com/en/article/how-do-i-sign-up-drl2i2/): Account registration guide with Google, Clever, Microsoft & Facebook options
- [How do I get started as a student?](https://help.sutori.com/en/article/how-do-i-get-started-as-a-student-1onx8na/): Student onboarding guide for Sutori with Google, Clever & Microsoft login
